entities.summary: Geo Kahani is an entertainment channel of Geo network, broadcasting in Urdu. Some of the most popular dramas are Naagin, Champa Aur Chambeli and Kiran. Geo Kahani began its transmission in the U.K. from 11 August 2017, ending the four-year run of Geo Tez, and ended its U.K. transmission in 2020.
